notes: Two fixes: (1) counter detection now uses the **leftmost** `4` in row 63 (the trailing 4s are unused slots, so `rfind` was grabbing c63 instead of the real counter at c46 — this caused the bogus c63 reset and wrong counter positions). (2) ACTION1/ACTION2 now shift only the **lowest** non-1 block in the lane (matching E19/E21 where the 9/2 block at r28-31 stays put while the 0/e block moves), inste
